The Nifty 50 closed at 25,227.95, down 0.63% on the day, while the broader Nifty 500 fell 0.81%. Advances were limited to 119 stocks against 375 decliners, giving a breadth score of 69.2 (rated “HEALTHY”). The India VIX, a volatility gauge, held steady at 15.52, indicating modest market anxiety. Bank Nifty slipped 0.38% to 62,038.65, though it remains up 2.05% over the past five sessions.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹5,866.78 cr today and a cumulative ₹28,493.99 cr over the last five days, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹3,159.90 cr. In options, the Nifty PCR (put‑call ratio) is 0.85, suggesting slightly more call than put interest; the max‑pain level sits at 25,050, with an expected range of 24,950‑25,505. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 1.18, indicating more put demand, and its max‑pain is 60,000. Key support‑resistance walls are at 24,000/26,000 for Nifty and 60,000/62,000 for Bank Nifty.

Watch the 25,216 S1 level for Nifty and 61,748 S1 for Bank Nifty as near‑term support. A break below these could test the 24,000 put wall on Nifty and 60,000 put wall on Bank Nifty. Conversely, a move above the 25,365 R1 (Nifty) or 62,346 R1 (Bank Nifty) would signal strength. Keep an eye on global cues such as Nvidia earnings and the upcoming RBI reverse‑repo auction, which may influence liquidity and sentiment.
